name: Dr. Tung's Smart Floss
description: Dr. Tung's Smart Floss, an expanding polyester floss with a cardamom flavor and a vegetable and beeswax coating. The brand states it is not made from PTFE.
features: The brand's product page says Smart Floss is polyester, flavored with cardamom essential oil, and coated with beeswax plus one or more of candelilla, carnauba, castor oil, and rice bran wax.
That page says the floss is not made from PTFE and is not intentionally treated with PFAS, PFOS, PFOA, or fluorinated surfactants.

In a January 21, 2025 post, the brand says a retest of multiple batches found no detectable organofluorine, and that a screening it describes as EPA-certified found none of more than 40 perfluorinated compounds. The post does not name the lab. This directory has not reviewed a report.
Amazon ASIN B00CQ7QHXY is a single pack. The listing bullets checked for this guide say the floss is free of BPA, PTFE, and petrochemical wax.
labelNote: The PFAS and organofluorine sentences are the brand's account. This directory has not run its own test.
